caption: The New Testament repeatedly applies Psalm 2’s royal sonship to Jesus. The link is explicit, though the psalm first described the reigning Davidic king.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 2 predict God’s Son? God declares the installed king His son. The New Testament repeatedly applies that royal language to Jesus.
slides.body: God declares the installed king His son. The New Testament repeatedly applies that royal language to Jesus.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 2 predict God’s Son?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 2:7: You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
